name: Conservatives
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of earthly authorities and the presence of wickedness in governance, as seen in Job's recognition that the earth is often under the control of the wicked (Job 9:24). Believers are called to submit to governing powers and be prepared for good works (Titus 3:1), while understanding that Christ's kingdom transcends worldly political systems (John 18:36). The coming of the Lord and His messenger serves as a reminder of God's ultimate authority and the need for faithful anticipation (Malachi 3:1), even as human leaders and religious figures, like the Pharisees, represent the existing order (Mark 7:1).
